name: RAG over Enterprise Docs
description: Retrieval-augmented generation over an indexed enterprise document store. The model answers or drafts using retrieved passages instead of relying on parametric memory alone.
mermaid_template:
flowchart LR
  U[User query] --> R[Retriever]
  R --> IDX[(Document Index)]
  R --> G[Generator model]
  G --> A[Answer with citations]

name: Agentic Workflow with Human-in-the-loop
description: A multi-step agent plans and executes a workflow across enterprise systems, pausing for human approval at defined checkpoints rather than acting fully autonomously.
mermaid_template:
flowchart LR
  U[Trigger] --> AG[Agent planner]
  AG --> T1[Tool / system call]
  AG --> CP{Checkpoint}
  CP -- approve --> T2[Next action]
  CP -- reject --> H[Human edits plan]
  T2 --> DONE[Workflow complete]

name: Real-time Copilot Sidecar
description: A low-latency assistant embedded alongside an existing application surface, suggesting actions or drafting content as the user works, without taking action itself.
mermaid_template:
flowchart LR
  APP[Host application] -- context --> SC[Copilot sidecar]
  SC --> M[Low-latency model]
  M --> SC
  SC -- suggestion --> APP

name: Batch Classification Pipeline
description: A scheduled or event-triggered pipeline that classifies or scores a high volume of records without a human in the loop per record.
mermaid_template:
flowchart LR
  SRC[(Source records)] --> Q[Batch queue]
  Q --> CL[Classifier model]
  CL --> OUT[(Scored output store)]

name: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration
description: Multiple specialized agents coordinate on a shared objective with minimal human checkpoints, each responsible for a distinct sub-task.
mermaid_template:
flowchart LR
  ORC[Orchestrator agent] --> A1[Sub-agent: research]
  ORC --> A2[Sub-agent: execution]
  ORC --> A3[Sub-agent: verification]
  A1 & A2 & A3 --> ORC
  ORC --> OUT[Objective complete]
